The main takeaway from our work is that
the Lorentz force is not a universal force, but rather a force that is specific to the electromagnetic field and that has no fluid dynamical analog.
the Poynting vector is a vector field that is not necessarily orthogonal to the velocity field and therefore does not have to be zero for the flow to be irrotational.
the fluid dynamical Poynting law and Lorentz force can be used as a starting point for a new theory of turbulence.
